name: Modern Square TR90 Frame
concept: reading glasses — Modern Square TR90 Frame. A featherlight TR90 square frame with progressive-ready optics. Ageless design, modern fit. Featherlight TR90 with a crisp square profile. Fully supports single vision, blue light, and progressive lenses from -20.00 to +10.00 diopters. Scratch-resistant and UV400 protection come standard; upgrade to 1.61 or 1.67 high-index for a thinner, lighter lens. Featherlight TR90 (19.1 g). Crisp square profile, medium fit. Progressive-ready: -20.00 to +10.00 diopters. Scratch-resistant + UV400 protection standard. 1.61 / 1.67 high-index upgrade available. Virtual Try-On uses your real camera. Measure PD at home with your phone.
